name: no-phantom-questions
description: One matter is filed once and asked about at most once, and every question card the chat can draw is backed by a row on disk. The user said 'Remind me on Monday to go to the mom friend'; exactly one task was created and no clarification row existed, yet the chat drew a '2 QUESTIONS' card asking 'When should I remind you?' twice — one group title-only, the other wearing the real task's facts pills. The turn held TWO holdForClarification calls and no createTask: the first failed because the model omitted access_token (a tool argument it had to copy on every call), and the retry that repaired it hit the 12-open-question cap, so the server filed the matter with its guess and deliberately asked nothing. Both calls persisted as receipts and both were rendered as answerable questions.

steps.say: Remind me on Monday to go to the mom friend
